title: The Glory Days Have Arrived
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner reveals the reality of God's glory breaking into our lives and communities, transforming barren and unfruitful areas into overflowing sources of spiritual blessing. Join Pastor Chris as he unpacks the prophetic words of Amos 9:13, illuminating the manifestation of God's glory in our lives and the world around us. Get ready to enter the realm of God's glory and experience the miraculous flow of His presence, power, and favor.
